question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH item_wholesale AS (
    SELECT 
        vw.item_code,
        vc.category_name,
        SUM(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df vw
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vw.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE CAST(substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY vw.item_code, vc.category_name
),
item_loss AS (
    SELECT 
        iwh.item_code,
        iwh.category_name,
        iwh.total_wholesale_price,
        vl."loss_rate_%",
        vl."loss_rate_%" * iwh.total_wholesale_price / 100.0 as item_loss
    FROM item_wholesale iwh
    JOIN veg_loss_rate_df vl ON iwh.item_code = vl.item_code
),
wholesale_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        CAST(substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        AVG(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,
        SUM(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df vw
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vw.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE CAST(substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, CAST(substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
selling_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        CAST(substr(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        SUM(vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" * vt."qty_sold(kg)") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df vt
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vt.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE CAST(substr(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, CAST(substr(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
loss_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        category_name,
        SUM(total_wholesale_price) as total_wholesale_price,
        SUM(item_loss) as total_loss
    FROM item_loss
    GROUP BY category_name
),
avg_loss_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        AVG(vl."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df vl
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vl.item_code = vc.item_code
    GROUP BY vc.category_name
)
SELECT 
    wm.year,
    wm.category_name,
    ROUND(wm.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wm.max_wholesale_price - wm.min_wholesale_price, 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(wm.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(alr.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(lm.total_loss, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(sm.total_selling_price - wm.total_wholesale_price, 2) as profit
FROM wholesale_metrics wm
JOIN selling_metrics sm ON wm.category_name = sm.category_name AND wm.year = sm.year
JOIN loss_metrics lm ON wm.category_name = lm.category_name
JOIN avg_loss_rate alr ON wm.category_name = alr.category_name
ORDER BY wm.year, wm.category_name
